scripts.validate: pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm check-types && pnpm test
scripts.hooks:test: pnpm hooks:pre-commit && echo 'feat: test commit' | pnpm commitlint
scripts.hooks:skip: echo 'Use: git commit --no-verify' && echo 'Or: HUSKY=0 git commit'
scripts.commit:help:
echo '
📝 Conventional Commit Format:

  <type>(<scope>): <subject>

Types:
  feat     ✨ New feature
  fix      🐛 Bug fix
  docs     📚 Documentation
  style    💄 Code style (formatting)
  refactor ♻️  Code refactoring
  perf     ⚡ Performance improvement
  test     ✅ Tests
  build    📦 Build system/dependencies
  ci       👷 CI/CD configuration
  chore    🔧 Maintenance tasks
  revert   ⏪ Revert commits

Examples:
  feat(ui): add Button component
  fix(api): handle null response
  docs: update README
'
scripts.ci: turbo run build lint check-types test --affected
scripts.ci:full: pnpm format:check && turbo run build lint check-types test
scripts.changeset:version: changeset version && git add -A && git commit -m 'chore: version packages' --no-verify
scripts.release: pnpm ci:full && pnpm changeset:version && pnpm changeset:publish
scripts.release:dry: pnpm ci:full && changeset version && changeset publish --dry-run
scripts.flow:feature:start: read -p 'Feature name: ' name && git flow feature start "$name"
scripts.flow:release:start: read -p 'Version (e.g. 1.0.0): ' ver && git flow release start "$ver"
scripts.flow:release:finish: read -p 'Version: ' ver && git flow release finish "$ver"
scripts.flow:hotfix:start: read -p 'Hotfix version: ' ver && git flow hotfix start "$ver"
scripts.flow:hotfix:finish: read -p 'Hotfix version: ' ver && git flow hotfix finish "$ver"
scripts.flow:status: git branch -a && echo '\n--- Current branch ---' && git branch --show-current
scripts.git:merge:main: git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main
scripts.git:merge:develop: git fetch origin develop && git merge origin/develop
scripts.git:rebase:main: git fetch origin main && git rebase origin/main
scripts.git:rebase:develop: git fetch origin develop && git rebase origin/develop
scripts.git:release: git checkout main && git merge develop && git checkout develop
scripts.undo:commit:n: echo 'Undo N commits: git reset --soft HEAD~N'
scripts.undo:deleted:file: echo 'Restore deleted file: git checkout HEAD -- <file>'
scripts.undo:deleted:branch: echo 'Find: git reflog | grep <branch>\nRestore: git checkout -b <branch> <sha>'
scripts.undo:push: echo '⚠️ DANGER: git push --force-with-lease origin <branch>\nOnly use if you are the only one on this branch!'
scripts.undo:wrong-branch: echo '1. git stash\n2. git checkout <correct-branch>\n3. git stash pop'
scripts.undo:wrong-branch:committed:
echo '1. git log (copy commit SHA)
2. git checkout <correct-branch>
3. git cherry-pick <sha>
4. git checkout <wrong-branch>
5. git reset --hard HEAD~1'
scripts.undo:wip: git stash push -m 'WIP: work in progress'
scripts.undo:help:
echo '
🔄 Git Undo Commands:

📝 STAGING:
  undo:unstage         - Unstage all files (keep changes)
  undo:add             - Unstage all (alias)

💾 COMMITS:
  undo:commit          - Undo last commit (keep staged)
  undo:commit:keep     - Undo last commit (keep unstaged)
  undo:commit:discard  - Undo last commit (discard changes) ⚠️
  undo:amend           - Add to last commit (same msg)
  undo:amend:msg       - Add to last commit (edit msg)

🔀 MERGES & REBASES:
  undo:merge           - Abort ongoing merge
  undo:merge:done      - Undo completed merge
  undo:rebase          - Abort ongoing rebase
  undo:rebase:done     - Undo completed rebase
  undo:cherry-pick     - Abort cherry-pick

📂 FILES & CHANGES:
  undo:changes         - Discard all local changes ⚠️
  undo:deleted:file    - Restore deleted file
  undo:clean-untracked - Remove untracked files ⚠️
  undo:clean-untracked:dry - Preview what would be removed

📦 STASH (temp save):
  undo:wip             - Stash work in progress
  undo:wip:restore     - Restore stashed work
  undo:stash:list      - Show all stashes

🔍 RECOVERY:
  undo:find-lost       - Find lost commits (reflog)
  undo:deleted:branch  - Recover deleted branch
  undo:detached-head   - Fix detached HEAD

⚠️ PUSHED CHANGES:
  undo:last-push       - Revert last pushed commit (safe)
  undo:push            - Force push (dangerous!)
'
scripts.gh:help:
echo '
🐙 GitHub CLI Commands:

Pull Requests:
  gh:pr:create      - Create PR (auto-fill from commits)
  gh:pr:create:draft - Create draft PR
  gh:pr:list        - List open PRs
  gh:pr:view        - Open PR in browser
  gh:pr:checkout    - Checkout a PR locally
  gh:pr:merge       - Squash merge & delete branch
  gh:pr:ready       - Mark draft as ready
  gh:pr:checks      - View CI status

Issues:
  gh:issue:list     - List open issues
  gh:issue:create   - Create new issue
  gh:issue:view     - Open issue in browser

Workflows:
  gh:workflow:list  - List workflows
  gh:workflow:view  - View recent runs
  gh:workflow:watch - Watch running workflow

Repo:
  gh:repo:view      - Open repo in browser
  gh:release:list   - List releases
  gh:release:create - Create new release
'
scripts.cli:install: pnpm build --filter=@repo/cli && cd packages/cli && pnpm link --global
scripts.cli:watch: cd packages/cli && pnpm link --global && pnpm dev
scripts.new:package: echo '\n📦 Creating new package...\n' && read -p 'Package name (e.g., auth): ' name && mkdir -p packages/$name/src && cd packages/$name && pnpm init && echo 'Created packages/$name - Add package.json config manually'
scripts.new:app: echo '\n🚀 Creating new app...\n' && read -p 'App name (e.g., admin): ' name && mkdir -p apps/$name && cd apps/$name && pnpm init && echo 'Created apps/$name - Add package.json config manually'
scripts.new:lib: echo '\n📚 Creating new library package...\n' && read -p 'Library name (e.g., hooks): ' name && mkdir -p packages/$name/{src,__tests__} && echo 'Created packages/$name with src and tests folders'
scripts.scaffold:help:
echo '
📋 Scaffold New Projects:

1. Package (shared library):
   pnpm new:lib <name>
   - Creates: packages/<name>/{src,__tests__}
   - Copy package.json from packages/validators
   - Update name, description, exports

2. App (Next.js/web app):
   pnpm new:app <name>
   - Creates: apps/<name>
   - Or use: pnpm dlx create-next-app@latest apps/<name>

3. After creation:
   - Add to pnpm-workspace.yaml if needed
   - Run: pnpm install
   - Add changeset: pnpm changeset
'
scripts.postinstall: playwright install chromium --with-deps || echo 'Playwright browser installation skipped'
